mapper.update: UPDATE app.announcement SET status = '1' WHERE status = '0'

UPDATE app.announcement a SET status = '9' WHERE a.status = '1' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app.announcement_region ar JOIN app.zip_code_master z ON (ar.city_code IS NOT NULL AND z.city_code = ar.city_code) OR (ar.city_code IS NULL AND z.prefecture_code = ar.prefecture_code) WHERE ar.announcement_id = a.announcement_id )
UPDATE app.announcement SET status = '2', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = '1'
